scope: Two bounded English/French application reply dispositions following model routing, for direct appointment requests that otherwise receive misleading capability replies.

appointmentPreservation.trigger: One complete, current, unquoted imperative requesting no appointment write, using finite negative appointment verbs and bounded provider/day/clock tails. No calendar field is parsed or stored.
appointmentPreservation.english: Understood; this request makes no appointment changes.
appointmentPreservation.french: Compris; cette demande ne modifie aucun rendez-vous.
appointmentPreservation.priority: After existing question, organizational reminder, interaction and record-preservation recovery; before existing reading and symptom recovery.

appointmentNoteContent.trigger: One complete, direct, unquoted affirmative request to prepare appointment notes or clinician questions, without supplied content, dates or extra tasks.
appointmentNoteContent.english: What content or questions would you like to include in your appointment note?
appointmentNoteContent.french: Quel contenu ou quelles questions voulez-vous inclure dans votre note de rendez-vous?
appointmentNoteContent.priority: After every existing source-specific recovery and before the generic rejected-action clarification. A successfully validated copy_note route remains the existing note action.

excluded: Questions, quoted requests or supplied quoted content, reports/history, third-party framing, hypothetical or conditional/exception clauses.
Mixed/appended requests, unknown free tails, control characters, chat markers and oversized input.
The note clarification excludes supplied content and does not invent medical questions, diagnoses, appointment details or record capabilities.
provenance: Raw routing, validation errors and model failures retain their original attribution. Accepted replies and applicationDecision are recorded as application dispositions. Neither disposition saves a note or changes a record, and neither earns raw routing, model prose or independent extraction credit.
unchangedRequirements: All 21 model routing alternatives, prompts, assets, runtime, sampling and token budgets remain unchanged.
Existing validation, reply-format guards, confirmation/save flows and callers remain unchanged.
Automatic remains the default; Qwen3.5-2B remains optional, with its original promotion gate blocked.
Frozen fixtures, scorer, qualitative criteria and acceptance gates remain unchanged.

Fresh revised-source Core/Runtime/native/Python/localization checks, xtool/app verification, full DEV and supplemental comparisons and all required reviews precede final freeze and paired held-out evaluation.
limitations: This scope registers behavior to validate. It supplies no passing test, model-quality, device-performance, source-freeze, held-out or Ready evidence. Original source14 failures and reviews remain preserved.
